projects.name: Implementing a New DC
details: Marks and Spencer (also known as M&S) is a British retailer headquartered in the City of Westminster, London, with over 700
stores in the United Kingdom and over 300 stores spread across more than 40 countries. It specializes in the selling of clothing and
luxury food products. This was a large program of 50 M ponds.
The task was to install a new Distribution center with the new package red prairie (external vendor - WMS. Package)
Customization of Red prairie as per requirement of M&S
Responsibilities:
Liaising with business to understand the Food DC (distribution center)
Implemented a new product for foods DC in M& S London (1 Yr.) using the red prairie product.
Creating the integration of red prairie with the other department like, inventory, Purchase order, shipping, logistics, POS
Used customer empathy and design thinking methodology to achieve the customer success
Got Appreciation from the Top Management for delivering the program on time in spite of lot of challenges, hence got a customer
satisfaction survey of 10/10
